## Reproduced findings

F1 — P2 / owning item P08.3: S6 ignores raw SQL integer columns.
Norm: @plan/decisions/D113.json:23 → @plan/knowledge/research-P08-design.json:29 (§4.3, any new smaller integer outside allowlist violates S6) and :34 (§5 S6). Implementation: scripts/schema-gate.php:223 checks integer Blueprint calls only; the SQL scanner at :231–261 checks ownership/object names but never SQL column types.
Reproduction: scripts/php84 php plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P08.10-review/reproduce-enforcement.php. In an isolated registered set, CREATE TABLE sys_gate_probe (id uuid NOT NULL, attempts integer NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT sys_gate_probe_pk PRIMARY KEY (id)) with an empty allowlist returns hits=[]; bigint control also returns hits=[]. Existing tests/Unit/SchemaGateTest.php:44 and :71 exercise Blueprint fixtures only. Raw SQL is a supported shipped migration idiom; this allows a counter narrowing to pass the promised type policy when a new snapshot is accepted. No currently shipped wrongly narrowed column is claimed.
Correction: extend S6 to statically supported raw CREATE/ALTER column DDL (or reject unsupported raw column definitions fail-closed), keeping exact table.column allowlist behavior. Add a raw integer negative and bigint/allowlisted positive control, then affected SchemaGate tests and schema-gate.

F2 — P2 / owning item P08.3: PG Golden loses NULLS NOT DISTINCT uniqueness semantics.
Norm: @plan/decisions/D113.json:23 → @plan/knowledge/research-P08-design.json:29 (§4.5 preserved constraints) and :34 (§5 canonical catalogue / Golden DDL). Implementation: tests/Golden/Support/SchemaCatalogue.php:64–77 projects index name/kind/columns/predicate/method without indnullsnotdistinct or the complete index definition; pg_constraint at :88 includes only FK/CHECK, so no other projection preserves it.
Same reproduction script, isolated corex_test transaction: create named UNIQUE (... workspace_id, code) NULLS NOT DISTINCT, capture catalogue, replace it with ordinary UNIQUE of identical name/columns, capture again. catalogues_equal=true although pg_get_indexdef differs; the ordinary index accepts two (NULL, 'same') rows. Transaction rolled back; remaining_table=null. The defect can hide an actual semantic regression in shipped sys_settings, root_feature_flags, aut_role_matrix/assignments and CRM nullable-scope uniqueness. Existing supplemental CRM raw snapshots/tests preserve the current baseline but do not repair the general Golden comparison.
Correction: serialize null-distinctness (and retain any other agreed semantic index identity) into the PG catalogue, add a focused negative regression for toggling it, intentionally enrich PG Goldens without changing DDL, and run affected PG Golden. Keep SQLite projection compatible or validate its affected shared code only.

Exact stdout for both reproductions: @plan/artifacts/P08.10-review/reproduce-enforcement.log, script exit 0 (successful reproduction, not a passing acceptance for these defects). No untested suspicion is counted as a finding.
